$schema-note: Runs on Your Battery Finder — real dataset. Each row hand-verified for battery interface + fit-type per docs/methodology. affiliate.affiliate_url is a real, working product/search URL (Amazon, or a manufacturer/retailer product page when that gave a more precise link) — no Amazon Associates account yet, so no affiliate tagging (see SITE.monetization.affiliate, stays false). Coverage per docs/research/2026-09-06-battery-platform-gadget-inventory.md: DeWalt 20V MAX, Milwaukee M18, Milwaukee M12, Ryobi 18V ONE+, Makita 18V LXT, HART 20V, Craftsman V20 — seven hand-verified platforms. Milwaukee M18/M12 and Makita 18V LXT hardware is identical in the EU/UK, so those rows also apply to EU/UK owners of the same platform (see /methodology). Bauer, Kobalt, Ridgid, EGO, Ryobi 40V, Makita CXT, Skil, Metabo HPT, Black+Decker, Porter-Cable, WORX, Flex, Greenworks, and all EU-only platforms (Bosch, Einhell, AEG, Metabo/CAS, Parkside, Ferrex) had no verified non-tool gadget accessories found in the 2026-09-06 research pass, so are omitted rather than published unverified — see /methodology for the running coverage list.
